minutes_text:
ADJOURNED EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MEETING
  MINUTES
  APRIL 29, 2019

An adjourned meeting of the Equestrian Committee of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was
called to order by CHAIRMAN HUFF at 7:05 p.m.

Committee Members Present:  Huff, Brtis, Ciarolla, Silvano, Shinn, Zigrang

Committee Members Absent:  Dean-Porter, Harik, Kemp

City Staff Present:  Community Services Director, Andy Clark
  Community Services Coordinator, Daniel A-Haja

DRAFT MINUTES OF MARCH 25, 2019

MEMBER SILVANO moved, seconded by MEMBER SHINN

  TO APPROVE THE DRAFT MINUTES OF THE MARCH 25, 2019 EQUESTRIAN
  COMMITTEE MEETING AS PRESENTED.

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIRMAN HUFF SO ORDERED.

AUDIENCE ITEMS NOT ON THE AGENDA

Pam Schachter, 45 Ranchview Road, inquired about the Dapplegray Park Junior Dressage
manual sprinkler valve. The Community Services Director responded that the valve would be
installed during the month of May.

CALIFORNIA WATER SERVICE COMPANY WATER RELIABILITY PROJECT MONTHLY
UPDATE

Korey Bradbury from California Water Service Company distributed project update fact sheets
and highlighted the progress made thus far. He described the work on the Palomino Ranchos
Trail. Mr. Bradbury reported a delay in the project due to the discovery of an asbestos lined
pipe in the L.A. County Botanic Gardens. MEMBER BRTIS noted that more water will likely
flow from rolling hills United Methodist Church into the Crenshaw tunnel due to recent
construction.

HEARING NO OBJECTION, CHAIRMAN HUFF THANKED MR. BRADBURY AND RECEIVED
AND FILED THIS AGENDA ITEM.

EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MINUTES  1
APRIL 29, 2019
 PROPOSED CHANDLER PARK ARENA THIRD HORSE TRAINER RULE CHANGE

While MEMBER SHINN originally thought the third dressage trainer may be a good idea, she
reported she is against this proposal. Audience member, Pam Schachter, proposed that the
Committee consider a 6-horse maximum in the Chandler Park arena, but Committee Members
disagreed. She further noted that a Code Enforcement Officer should check this arena on
Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays between 9:00 a.m.-11:00 a.m. to look for three trainer
violations.

MEMBER SHINN moved, seconded by MEMBER SILVANO

  NO CHANDLER PARK ARENA RULE CHANGES BE MADE AT THIS TIME

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIRMAN HUFF SO ORDERED.

MAY 2019 EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MEETING

The Community Services Director reported that the fourth Monday in May is a Memorial Day
Holiday which requires the Equestrian Committee meeting to be held on Tuesday, May 28,
2019. He noted that this is a City Council meeting night and that the Equestrian meeting could
be held at 6:00 p.m. that evening. CHAIRMAN HUFF indicated that Equestrian Committee
should be held at that time unless she is called into a City Council closed session meeting at
the same time.

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIRMAN HUFF SO ORDERED.

EQUESTRIAN ISSUES LOG

The Equestrian Committee briefly discussed the three issues reported.

HEARING NO OBJECTION, CHAIRMAN HUFF RECEIVED AND FILED THE REPORT.

COMMITTEE REPORTS

A.  MAYOR’S BREAKFAST RIDE – MAY 4, 2019

The Community Services Director reported that MEMBER SHINN has volunteered to be the
Ride Leader this year. In order to attract more east-side equestrians, MEMBER SHINN
recommended that we have a crossing guard at Rolling Hills Road and Palos Verdes Drive
North. MEMBER BRTIS suggested a sign be posted that the Blossom’s Trail was open to allow
equestrians use of the Crenshaw Tunnel. The Community Services Director reported that he
would address both requests.

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIRMAN HUFF SO ORDERED.

EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MINUTES  2
APRIL 29, 2019
 B.  HORSE TRAILERING DEMONSTRATION – MAY 18, 2019

The Community Services Director reported that as part of the Equine Emergency Preparedness
Committee’s goals a Horse Trailering Demonstration will be led by Sean Martin on May 18,
2019 at Ernie Howlett Park.

CHAIRMAN HUFF reported that staff is working on an electronic horse census form.
MEMBERS SHINN and SILVANO were pleased to hear this and would like to further discuss it
at the next Equine Emergency Preparedness Committee meeting.

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIRMAN HUFF SO ORDERED.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

A.  PV PENINSULA WATER RELIABILITY PROJECT UPDATE – Monthly

B.  EQUINE EMERGENCY RESPONSE PLAN UPDATE – Monthly

C.  BROWN ACT REVIEW (JUNE 2019)

D.  HORSE CENSUS (MAY 28, 2019)

E.  PALOS VERDES DRIVE EAST TRAIL REPAIR (MAY 28, 2019)

ADJOURNMENT

MEMBER SILVANO moved, seconded by MEMBER CIAROLLA

  TO ADJOURN THE EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MEETING TO TUESDAY MAY 28,
  2019 AT 6:00 P.M. IN THE CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS.

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIRMAN HUFF ADJOURNED THE MEETING.

The meeting adjourned at 7:47 p.m.

Respectfully submitted,

Andy Clark
Community Services Director

APRIL 29, 2019
